item.title: Claude Code on the Web: Power, Productivity, and a Whole Lot of New Risk
item.description:
Author: Dan Guido
Date: 2023-11-07
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Cybersecurity", "Software Development", "AI Ethics", "Enterprise Technology"]
Summary:
  • Claude 3 is a powerful AI assistant from Anthropic.
  • It improves code generation and reasoning.
  • It can access and manipulate live web content.
  • This boosts productivity but raises security risks.
  • Organizations must update defenses and monitor AI use.
  • Balancing innovation with security is essential.

item.title: Toloka podcast: How RL Gyms are redefining data for AI agents
AI Agent Security: How to Protect Autonomous Systems
item.description:
Author: Rodrigo Fernández
Date: October 22, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Autonomous Systems", "Cybersecurity", "Enterprise AI", "AI Governance"]
Summary:
  • AI agents automate tasks and make autonomous decisions.
  • They increase organizational attack surfaces.
  • Security involves managing agent identity and access.
  • Protecting agents requires lifecycle oversight and policy enforcement.
  • Different agent types need tailored security approaches.
  • Visibility and control ensure trustworthy AI operations.

item.title: LLM Risks: Enterprise Threats and How to Secure Them
item.description:
Author: Elad Schulman
Date: October 21, 2025
Tags: ["Enterprise Security", "Artificial Intelligence", "Data Privacy", "Cybersecurity", "Large Language Models"]
Summary:
  • LLMs introduce new security risks beyond traditional software vulnerabilities.
  • Risks include data leakage, prompt injection, and model poisoning.
  • Enterprises must adopt new security measures for LLMs.
  • Key strategies include data governance, prompt filtering, and access controls.
  • Monitoring and regular updates are essential to secure LLM deployments.
  • LLMs require tailored security frameworks to protect enterprise data.

item.title: Cross Session Leak: when your AI assistant becomes a data breach
item.description:
Author: Raphaël Benitte
Date: 2023-07-18
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Data Security", "Privacy", "Cybersecurity", "Software Development"]
Summary:
  • AI assistants handle more sensitive data daily.
  • Cross-session leaks expose data between user sessions.
  • These leaks occur due to poor session management.
  • Consequences include privacy violations and reputational damage.
  • Developers must enforce strict security measures to prevent leaks.

item.title: LLM business alignment: Detecting AI hallucinations and misaligned agentic behavior in business systems
item.description:
Author: Giskard Team
Date: 2023-08-15
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Business Automation", "AI Safety", "Machine Learning", "Natural Language Processing"]
Summary:
  • LLMs transform business automation but pose risks like hallucinations.
  • Hallucinations produce plausible yet incorrect outputs.
  • Misaligned behavior causes AI to stray from business goals.
  • Detection uses fact-checking and domain validators.
  • Alignment needs clear goals and human oversight.
  • Tools like Giskard help evaluate and align models.
